theme: Premium Dark Mode (Neo-Glass) with Vibrant Data Accents

rules: CRITICAL: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk, or Open Sans for headings.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em] text-xs font-semibold).
BANNED: Purple-dominant palettes (#7351B7) and teal green (#1B93A4).
Use vivid, saturated colors ONLY for data visualization, risk matrix cells, and status badges to achieve the 'colourful and premium' look.
Maintain a structural dark slate/navy grayscale to anchor the bright colors.

effects: Add a subtle ambient glow (blur-3xl opacity-10) behind primary chart components using the dominant chart color.
Glassmorphism for floating elements (dropdowns, tooltips): bg-[#131B2C]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10.

layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding: use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent data from feeling cramped.
rules: Never fill 100% of the grid with equal squares. Use col-span-8 for primary charts (ESG Breakdown) and col-span-4 for summaries.
Risk Matrix should be prominently displayed (col-span-full or large section).

components.cards: Premium tactile surfaces: rounded-2xl bg-[#131B2C] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors shadow-sm
components.charts: Use Recharts. Tooltips MUST have a solid dark background (bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700) to avoid text bleeding into underlying charts.
components.risk_matrix: A highly visual 2D grid/heat map. Use rich gradients or solid vivid colors (Emerald, Yellow, Orange, Red) with dark, high-contrast labels inside.
components.progress_bars: Rounded-full, h-2 or h-3, using bright accent colors (e.g., emerald for training completion) on a dark slate track (bg-slate-800).
components.tables: Cardless integration for Supplier Ranking. Left-aligned, subtle border-b on rows (border-slate-800). Highlight top performers with subtle row backgrounds.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items on load.
motion.interactive: Active states must slightly scale down (active:scale-95).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast compliance, especially for text placed over colored Risk Matrix cells.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='esg-score-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: You must write .js files (not .tsx) for all React components.
Implement the UI as a Dashboard SaaS layout with a premium dark mode.
Ensure 'Supplier Ranking Overview' feels like a high-end command center: lots of data, cleanly spaced, with pops of vibrant color for scores and risks.
The Risk Matrix must be the visual centerpiece: vibrant, color-coded cells clearly displaying sustainability risks.
Include specific sections for ESG Score Breakdown, Document/Training Progress, and Attention Required alerts.
Do not use default generic styling; elevate the components with the specified spacing, rounded corners, and subtle borders.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds over content (especially for tooltips, modals, and sticky headers).
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
Never use AI emojis (🤖, 💡, etc.) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
